summary.name: Arroxy
summary.one_liner: Arroxy is a free, open-source graphical front end for yt-dlp that downloads videos, audio, playlists and subtitles from YouTube and other supported sites.
use_cases: Download YouTube videos for offline viewing
Run a portable downloader without installing
summary.what_it_does: Arroxy is a desktop app that wraps yt-dlp in a graphical interface. According to the page, it downloads video (up to 8K), audio as MP3, full playlists and subtitles from YouTube and over 2000 sites. The page says it has no ads and needs no account. It can be installed via winget or Scoop on Windows, or downloaded as an installer or portable .exe. The app can start updates to the installed version from within itself. The page lists Windows, Mac and Linux as supported platforms in its title and description.
notable: Installable via winget and Scoop on Windows
Supports up to 8K video and MP3 extraction
caveats: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch because the app is not signed with a paid certificate
Installation instructions shown on the page cover Windows only; Mac and Linux install steps are not given in the page text
